plugin.name: Discord Adapter
plugin.description: Connects to Discord so the catgirl replies to text, images and documents in server channels and DMs.
plugin.short_description: Catgirl integration for Discord channels and DMs, with image and document support.
page.title: Discord Adapter
page.subtitle: Bring the catgirl into your Discord server: @ her in a channel, DM her, send her images and documents.
actions.save_hint: Click Start listening after saving; settings cannot be changed while listening.
status.title: Status
basic.title: Basic settings
basic.trigger_all: All messages in whitelisted channels + all DMs
basic.admin_hint: Discord Settings → Advanced → enable Developer Mode → right-click a user → Copy User ID. Admins are treated as the master.
guide.title: How to create a Discord Bot (4 steps)
guide.step1: Open the Discord Developer Portal and click New Application.
guide.step2: Bot page → Reset Token → copy the token and paste it above.
guide.step3: Critical: on the same Bot page, scroll to Privileged Gateway Intents and enable Message Content Intent, otherwise the catgirl cannot read message content.
guide.step4: OAuth2 → URL Generator → check bot → Bot Permissions: Send Messages / Read Message History / Embed Links / Attach Files → open the generated link to invite the bot to your server.
